rows.label: tlk70000068_03_msg0001
rows.name:
A gardener's job isn't just pushing
around rocks and sand to make
everything look pretty, you know.

rows.label: tlk70000068_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Dad says it isn't just rocks and sand.
You need to know how soil, plants, and
everything else work together...

rows.label: tlk70000068_03_msg0003
rows.name:
You need all kinds of knowledge to
tend a garden. It's like being a
doctor for gardens.

rows.label: tlk70000068_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Dad says his ultimate goal is to fix
gardens and heal the hearts of the
people who see them.

rows.label: tlk70000068_03_msg0005
rows.name:
It's so amazing I don't get it. I've
been with Dad a long time, but never
knew he thought like that.
